context:
Goal: triage's page writes stop skipping the item checks, and you can overrule any pick.
Problem (goal): triage took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 13:33 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (read): the lane brief says keep the change narrow; an older full fix (PR #1533, 23 files) was closed unmerged this morning.
Departs from: main — adds a fallback so the item checks find triage's page.
home: step page-checks-reach-triage (triage page writes pass the item checks)

options.gain: Small change, no clash with the lane reworking page answers.
options.how: The lane sends its one-function fix and test (branch page-checks-reach-triage-narrow) to review. Undo: drop that branch.
options.label: Keep the narrow fix (Recommended)
options.lose: Covers this repo's page only; one related gap stays open and the old full fix is dropped.

options.gain: The full fix, which already passed review once, covering the related gap too.
options.how: Reopen PR #1533's branch, bring it up to date with main, and review it again.
options.label: Overrule: revive the full fix
options.lose: 23 files, and it clashes with the lane reworking page answers.

reply: Closed: you overruled the narrow fix; the lane revives PR #1533's full fix, brings it up to date with main and sends it to review.
short: Narrow fix for triage page checks
title: Triage's page writes get the item checks through the narrow fix
why: A triage pick you could not see before.
